name: migrate
description: Migrate a Wrangler project to cf

arguments.name: path
arguments.description: Path to a Wrangler configuration file

options.name: bundler
options.description: Bundler to use in the migrated project (defaults to vite when @cloudflare/vite-plugin is declared, otherwise wrangler)

options.name: dry-run
options.description: Show the files that would change without writing them

options.name: force
options.description: Run even if the Git worktree is not clean

options.name: install
options.description: Install cf as a project dependency (use --no-install to skip)
